notes: The negative me and the negative indefinite ouden stand in different clauses, so rules 41 and 59 do not arise: ouden takes nothing in the main clause and me takes not in the purpose clause.
Both articles are emptied, one by the possessive adjective ses under rule 54 and one by the free genitive pronoun sou under rule 20.
choris is rendered by the single word without, so rule 101's trailing-preposition question does not arise.
